scope: Reviewed initial major-version public API baselines, not platform/package/release certification.
snapshotEncoding: UTF-8 without BOM, invariant LF, final newline
reviewedBoundaries: standard ports expose neutral immutable contracts
frontend has only one frontend and three explicitly advanced worker types
internal implementation APIs are delivered in the SDK but are not extra products
snapshotFacts: native function-pointer signatures and calling conventions
limitations: Not a universal nullable-annotation or custom-attribute compatibility analyzer; review contract/source semantics separately.
reviewedPreReleaseChanges: NativeBuildCommand.outputEncoding stores an optional neutral encoding name in the immutable command plan and receipt. Null retains the platform default; Meson explicitly selects UTF-8.
ProcessExecutor.ExecuteAsync accepts a final optional Encoding argument for both redirected streams. Existing tools retain their default decoding; no Python or Meson heuristic enters Infrastructure.

SourceSnapshotBatch.GetMismatch shares exact-record file and complete directory-query verification within one fence across Host and NativeBuild. Each later fence remains fresh; contradictory records, ordered exclusions, absence and cancellation remain independent. No legacy alias or production friend access is added.
